summary: The existing landing, invite signup, manual Supabase connection and read-only dashboard are ready for the first real-project trial. The full V1 plan still has implementation work in customer repair targeting, evidence, reporting and production operations.

owner.scope: Owns the project and decides what Pooltune may inspect or change.
owner.remaining: Customer permissions must be explicit before automatic work.

customer-db.scope: Rookery on Supabase supplies the measured staging workload.
customer-db.remaining: Live Rookery also verified the operator monitor with owned synthetic traffic. Ordinary customer workloads and additional providers remain unqualified.

model.scope: Claude interprets evidence and returns a typed proposal or no change.
model.remaining: Provider failures and incorrect decisions remain possible; Go must independently check every action.

collector.scope: Built in staging: collect enrolled query counters and detect repeated slowdowns.
collector.remaining: Broader signals, workload calibration and automatic query enrollment remain.

scheduler.scope: Built in staging: saved jobs, an always-on consumer, retries and delayed follow-ups survive restarts.
scheduler.remaining: Customer scheduling limits and abandoned-investigation lifecycle still need work.

state.scope: PostgreSQL retains enrolled query history, investigations and checkpoints. Preview account separation and bounded history passed local database tests.
state.remaining: Qualify backup and restore, retention under production load and key rotation.

investigator.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
investigator.remaining: Build: Expand enrolled query shapes and add evidence readers for more causes. Verify: Exercise competing causes and hosted recovery during a model call.
investigator.remainingBuild: Expand enrolled query shapes and add evidence readers for more causes.
investigator.remainingVerification: Exercise competing causes and hosted recovery during a model call.

tools.scope: All six bounded repair cases work. Some planned operations and general query targeting are still missing.
tools.remaining: Build: Select index candidates for customer queries; add individual-column statistics-target changes and table cleanup-threshold changes. Bind repairs to customer grants and target identities. Verify: Measure concurrent committed writes on repaired tables, real memory headroom and actual owner schedules.
tools.remainingBuild: Select index candidates for customer queries; add individual-column statistics-target changes and table cleanup-threshold changes. Bind repairs to customer grants and target identities.
tools.remainingVerification: Measure concurrent committed writes on repaired tables, real memory headroom and actual owner schedules.

inspection.scope: One owner-captured lookup and two ordinary-traffic plan shapes work through Railway.
inspection.remaining: Build: Expand ordinary capture to more workloads and add evidence for statistics, visibility, spill and scheduling. Verify: Qualify more plan shapes, distinct input patterns and pooled or Data API sessions.
inspection.remainingBuild: Expand ordinary capture to more workloads and add evidence for statistics, visibility, spill and scheduling.
inspection.remainingVerification: Qualify more plan shapes, distinct input patterns and pooled or Data API sessions.

experiments.scope: Controlled before-and-after trials passed in owned repair fixtures.
experiments.remaining: Build: Choose representative inputs and admit justified experiments for ordinary enrolled queries. Verify: Measure customer resource headroom and check interference with other traffic.
experiments.remainingBuild: Choose representative inputs and admit justified experiments for ordinary enrolled queries.
experiments.remainingVerification: Measure customer resource headroom and check interference with other traffic.

index.scope: Single-column and two-column index repairs passed. The compound executor uses the fixed lookup,padding test columns.
index.remaining: Build: Derive permitted table, columns and key order from an enrolled customer query. The current validator accepts only the scalar case or column numbers [2,3], and construction uses fixed names. Verify: Qualify each newly supported query shape, existing-index equivalence, storage cost and concurrent committed writes. Other shapes are not merely untested generic support.
index.remainingBuild: Derive permitted table, columns and key order from an enrolled customer query. The current validator accepts only the scalar case or column numbers [2,3], and construction uses fixed names.
index.remainingVerification: Qualify each newly supported query shape, existing-index equivalence, storage cost and concurrent committed writes. Other shapes are not merely untested generic support.

refresh.scope: Targeted ANALYZE case verified: refresh stale statistics and measure the result.
refresh.remaining: Broader stale-statistics signals and representative customer traffic remain.

richer.scope: Joint statistics for lookup,padding work. The planned individual-column detail adjustment is not implemented.
richer.remaining: Build: Add bounded ALTER COLUMN SET STATISTICS: read and save the old target, choose an allowed target, analyze, and restore when appropriate. Generalize joint-statistics targeting beyond the fixed pair. Verify: Test uneven value distributions, read benefit, analysis cost and restoration with real Claude.
richer.remainingBuild: Add bounded ALTER COLUMN SET STATISTICS: read and save the old target, choose an allowed target, analyze, and restore when appropriate. Generalize joint-statistics targeting beyond the fixed pair.
richer.remainingVerification: Test uneven value distributions, read benefit, analysis cost and restoration with real Claude.

cleanup.scope: Plain VACUUM passed. Planned changes to table cleanup-trigger thresholds are not implemented.
cleanup.remaining: Build: Add bounded table cleanup-threshold adjustments, including saved prior values, owner grants and restoration. Verify: Prove late cleanup triggering is the cause and that changed thresholds reduce recurring backlog without excess interference.
cleanup.remainingBuild: Add bounded table cleanup-threshold adjustments, including saved prior values, owner grants and restoration.
cleanup.remainingVerification: Prove late cleanup triggering is the cause and that changed thresholds reduce recurring backlog without excess interference.

memory.scope: Function-memory case verified with attributed disk spill and a fixed test memory budget.
memory.remaining: Customer memory headroom, representative functions and wider concurrency remain.

cron.scope: Scheduling case verified: move one job to an allowed quiet minute and preserve deadlines after restart.
cron.remaining: Real customer schedules, broader interference and safe recovery windows remain.

recovery.scope: Staging verification measures benefit and protected traffic; saved intent supports repair-specific recovery.
recovery.remaining: Customer lifecycle, uncertain external changes and broader failure coverage remain.

backend.scope: An owner-scoped hosted service validates the dedicated Supabase login and controls its worker and saved history.
backend.remaining: Add automated credential rotation and qualify production account and deployment operations.

dashboard.scope: An invited account connected to Rookery through the dashboard, read a measured-plan Sonnet diagnosis and resumed polling after reconnect.
dashboard.remaining: Public onboarding, account recovery, and a seven-day workload pilot remain.

studio.scope: Studio graph registration and scripted replay exist. The Studio export is not connected to live Go evidence tools.
studio.remaining: Build: Attach an authorized Go evidence bridge to developer graph sessions and correlate worker, queue, graph, action and verification events in a visible run history. Verify: Show an actual hosted run end to end, including a requested Go read and the applied/verified result. The recorded earlier viewer proof is API registration/scripted replay, not this full live view.
studio.remainingBuild: Attach an authorized Go evidence bridge to developer graph sessions and correlate worker, queue, graph, action and verification events in a visible run history.
studio.remainingVerification: Show an actual hosted run end to end, including a requested Go read and the applied/verified result. The recorded earlier viewer proof is API registration/scripted replay, not this full live view.

screen-evidence.scope: Built: check supplied measurements and skip unsupported or healthy cases.
screen-evidence.remaining: Broader diagnosis must still use fresh evidence and retain no-change outcomes.

model-recommendation.scope: Built: send plan, index checks and the supplied cause evidence together; validate the response.
model-recommendation.remaining: This card describes the original one-call path. The separate diagnostic loop is built and can request evidence; broader customer diagnosis remains.

diagnose-causes.scope: Sonnet passed 18/18 bounded replay cases. All six owned repair routes passed hosted diagnostic runs; a separate hosted probe requested missing evidence.
diagnose-causes.remaining: Sonnet also used evidence from one owner-captured lookup and two ordinary-traffic plan shapes. Broader queries and competing causes remain.

request-evidence.scope: Named Go readers and local durable evidence recovery are built. A separate Railway/Rookery test had real Sonnet request fresh ANALYZE evidence before choosing a repair; no repair executed in that probe.
request-evidence.remaining: Requested hosted evidence for the remaining families and hosted mid-model checkpoint recovery remain unqualified.

repair-coverage.scope: The six bounded repair families ran on owned fixtures. The hosted customer project worker currently ends at a read-only diagnosis.
repair-coverage.remaining: Connect the owner-granted repair and verification workflow to hosted projects. Implement real-query index candidate selection, individual-column statistics targets and cleanup-threshold changes. Qualify committed writes, resource limits and owner schedules.

connect-project.scope: The hosted preview verifies a manually installed Rookery role, activates its worker and shows an enrolled diagnosis.
connect-project.remaining: Qualify the intended pilot project and additional query routes. Expand onboarding beyond the preview.

credential-lifecycle.scope: The hosted preview encrypts each project’s monitor credentials. Rookery passed disconnect and reconnect. The operator path also verified revocation and manual password rotation.
credential-lifecycle.remaining: Add managed credential and encryption-key rotation, then verify recovery and disconnect during failures or replica changes.
credential-lifecycle.remainingBuild: Add managed credential and encryption-key rotation.
credential-lifecycle.remainingVerification: Exercise deployed worker and state-store failures. Verify credential handling and disconnect before scaling beyond one replica.

auth.scope: Invite signup, email/password sign-in, session expiry and sign-out work. Two test accounts were kept separate.
auth.remaining: Public registration, email verification and password recovery remain.

activity.scope: The dashboard showed query windows, a healthy control, monitor checks and a Sonnet diagnosis with a measured plan. The diagnosis remained visible after reconnect.
activity.remaining: Qualify a full pilot week and broaden customer-facing repair history and reporting.

landing.scope: The existing basic landing page explains read-only Supabase monitoring and links to Create account and Sign in. Signed-in owners can open their workspace.
landing.remaining: Accounts require an invite. Public registration and recovery are tracked on Sign-in and account access.

operations.scope: Staging has a healthy single-replica preview and tested account isolation and limits. Production recovery and operations still need qualification.
operations.remaining: Qualify backup and restore, credential rotation, deploy and outage behavior, and the seven-day pilot.

hosted-diagnostic-integration.scope: Connected and verified for the owned index fixture: Railway queue → diagnostic Sonnet graph → Go index repair → measured improvement. Queued job survived an actual service restart.
hosted-diagnostic-integration.remaining: The bounded single-column service-restart proof remains distinct from the newer per-repair runs. All six routes are implemented; see each connection for its verified scope. Hosted mid-model recovery remains.

diagnostic-adapter-coverage.scope: All five existing repair tools now run through the shared diagnostic investigator and guarded Go executor, with real Sonnet and owned Rookery traffic.
diagnostic-adapter-coverage.remaining: General customer collectors, requested-reader coverage across every family and broader workload qualification remain.

index-single.scope: Single-column index case verified with real Claude and ongoing traffic.
index-single.remaining: Broader query shapes and committed writes to the repaired table remain; the bounded two-column case has its own verified node.

index-compound.scope: One ordered two-column nonunique B-tree case passed real Sonnet, guarded build, before/after traffic and cleanup in Railway/Rookery. Local tests cover identity and interrupted recovery.
index-compound.remaining: Broader compound query shapes, customer grants and concurrent committed writes to the repaired table remain unqualified.

statistics-joint.scope: Joint-statistics case verified for related predicate columns.
statistics-joint.remaining: Column statistics targets and broader data distributions remain.

statistics-target.scope: Remaining V1 work: increase detail collected for an individual column when the measured evidence warrants it.
statistics-target.remaining: Implement bounded column targets, preserve prior settings and verify benefit, resource cost and recovery with real Claude.

cleanup-vacuum.scope: Plain VACUUM case verified: reduce visibility work without replacing the index.
cleanup-vacuum.remaining: Recurring cleanup settings and broader maintenance workloads remain.

cleanup-settings.scope: Remaining V1 work: qualify permitted cleanup threshold adjustments beyond the tested plain VACUUM operation.
cleanup-settings.remaining: Define allowed settings, admission, benefit verification and restoration before automatic changes.

diagnostic-analyze.scope: Statistics refresh: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-analyze.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-statistics.scope: Joint statistics: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-statistics.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-vacuum.scope: Targeted cleanup: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-vacuum.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-memory.scope: Function memory: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-memory.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

diagnostic-cron.scope: Job scheduling: diagnostic Sonnet chose the repair through the Railway consumer; Go applied it and verified benefit under owned Rookery traffic. Healthy and brief-spike controls passed.
diagnostic-cron.remaining: General customer enrollment and representative workloads remain. This successful action run reused initial evidence; it does not prove every named reader was requested live.

index-compound-general.scope: Build candidate selection beyond the fixed two-equality test query, then qualify the accepted query shapes.
index-compound-general.remaining: Build: Represent authorized real table/column identities and choose key order from query predicates. Define supported combinations such as equality with a range or ordering; do not assume all shapes are supported. Verify: Test accepted shapes with real Sonnet, representative inputs, existing indexes, writes, storage cost and interrupted recovery.
index-compound-general.remainingBuild: Represent authorized real table/column identities and choose key order from query predicates. Define supported combinations such as equality with a range or ordering; do not assume all shapes are supported.
index-compound-general.remainingVerification: Test accepted shapes with real Sonnet, representative inputs, existing indexes, writes, storage cost and interrupted recovery.

enrolled-lookup-diagnosis.scope: Real Sonnet used a measured sequential scan for one owner-approved Rookery lookup through Railway.
enrolled-lookup-diagnosis.remaining: This card covers one integer equality lookup. The ordinary-traffic plan card records two further query shapes. Broader diagnosis remains.

enrolled-lookup-evidence.scope: Real traffic counters and current index metadata passed under the exact owner grant. PostgreSQL recorded no lookup replay.
enrolled-lookup-evidence.remaining: Passive evidence for one integer equality lookup. The measured plan and ordinary-traffic plan cards show the separate verified plan paths.

hosted-enrolled-flow.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
hosted-enrolled-flow.remaining: The private operator worker is in standby after fixture cleanup. The dashboard has a separate verified owner flow. More workloads and hosted mid-model recovery remain.

enrolled-measured-plan.scope: One approved Rookery lookup returned one row and filtered 99,999 in a measured sequential scan. Railway attached the plan to a saved Sonnet diagnosis.
enrolled-measured-plan.remaining: Owner-operated sample for one exact lookup. See the ordinary-traffic plan card for sampled app executions.

enrolled-traffic-plans.scope: Two enrolled Rookery query shapes passed ordinary-traffic plan capture and saved a Sonnet diagnosis through Railway.
enrolled-traffic-plans.remaining: Requires opt-in logging for a dedicated direct login on the primary. More workloads, pooled and Data API sessions and cause-specific evidence remain.

project-activity-history.scope: Project-scoped polls, query windows and diagnosis timings are visible in the owning account’s Railway dashboard and history download. Reconnect preserved the diagnosis.
project-activity-history.remaining: Qualify a full week of ordinary customer traffic and its dashboard history.

preview-account-session.scope: Invite signup, email/password sign-in, session expiry and sign-out work. Two test accounts were kept separate.
preview-account-session.remaining: Public signup, email verification and password recovery remain.

hosted-preview-project.scope: An invited account connected to Rookery through the dashboard, read a measured-plan Sonnet diagnosis and resumed polling after reconnect.
hosted-preview-project.remaining: An owner can connect a project manually. The wider workload and week-long pilot qualifications remain.

preview-week-pilot.scope: Connect the intended Supabase project manually and observe a full week of ordinary traffic.
preview-week-pilot.remaining: Use the dashboard to review poll gaps, query timings, sustained slowdowns and diagnosis coverage.

colorMeaning: Green covers the verified scope on each card. Yellow means part of the card works and more remains. Dashed cards track pending work or qualification.
